totalNeedsMyDecision.description: TotalNeedsMyDecision is the number of the pending Requests that the User can currently decide on and has not decided on yet.

totalMyPending.description: TotalMyPending is the number of the pending Requests that are created by the User or whose subject is the User.

totalActiveAccess.description: TotalActiveAccess is the number of the active accesses of the User.

totalExpiringSoon.description: TotalExpiringSoon is the number of the active accesses of the User that end within the next hour.

totalAwaitingMyResponse.description: TotalAwaitingMyResponse is the number of the pending Requests of the User whose reviewers asked for more information.

isReviewer.description: IsReviewer is whether the User is a reviewer of at least one review Step of an enabled access Policy.

canRequestOnBehalf.description: CanRequestOnBehalf is whether the User can request at least one Catalog on behalf of others.

Inbox.title: Inbox
Inbox.description: Inbox is the set of the counters of the items that currently need a User's attention
